blocks.prompt: 12 In how many ways can 8 books including 2 on English be arranged on a shelf in such a way that the English books are never together?
blocks.explanation:
8 alag kitaabein shelf par lagani hain; un mein 2 English ki hain jo kabhi saath saath (bilkul ek doosre ke barabar) nahi aani chahiye.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: "kabhi saath nahi" = kul \(-\) saath. "Saath" ko block bana kar ginenge. Phir gap method se tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 alag kitaabein, jin mein 2 English ki.
Humein find karna hai: woh tarteebein jin mein English kitaabein kabhi saath na hon.
Tareeqa: Saath nahi = kul \(-\) saath. "Saath" ke liye dono English kitaabon ko rubber band se baandh kar ek block bana do.

Kul tarteebein
\[8! = 40320\]
Kyun: 8 alag kitaabein, 8 jagahein, koi shart nahi.

English kitaabein saath hon
\[\text{Units} = 1 + 6 = 7\]
\[7! \times 2! = 5040 \times 2 = 10080\]
Kyun: English block ek unit aur baqi 6 kitaabein, kul 7 units, \(7!\) tareeqon se. Block ke andar dono English kitaabein jagah badal sakti hain (pehle Grammar phir Literature, ya ulta), is liye \(2!\).
Dhyan dein: Block ke andar ka \(2!\) bhool gaye to jawab \(40320 - 5040 = 35280\) aayega, jo ghalat hai.

Minus karein
\[8! - 7! \times 2!\]
\[= 40320 - 10080 = 30240\]
Kyun: Kul mein se "saath" wali tarteebein nikaal di; jo bachi un mein English kitaabein kabhi saath nahi.

Tasdeeq (gap method)
Pehle baqi 6 kitaabein lagao: \(6! = 720\). Un ke beech aur dono kinaron par 7 khaali jagahein (gaps) banti hain. 2 English kitaabein 2 alag gaps mein: \({}^{7}P_{2} = 42\).
\[720 \times 42 = 30240 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Alag alag gaps mein rakhi kitaabon ke beech kam az kam ek doosri kitaab hoti hai, is liye woh kabhi saath nahi aa saktin. Do bilkul alag tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaya.
